draft.headline: OpenAI and Anthropic cut off data access, forcing Z.AI and Moonshot AI to delay flagship models.
draft.threads_post:
OpenAI and Anthropic have shut the door on their training data for Chinese AI developers.

Because of the cutoff, companies Z.AI and Moonshot AI are delaying their next flagship models. With their primary sources blocked, developers are turning to Google and Meta for new training data.

Will switching to Google and Meta data be enough to keep these labs on track?
